newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japanese net foreign bond buyers in Sept - MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japanese net foreign bond buyers in Sept - MOF.

text.p: Net purchases of foreign bonds by Japanese investors totalled 440.1 billion yen in September after net purchases of 1.2004 trillion yen a month earlier, the Ministry of Finance (MOF) said on Monday.
Bonds include beneficiary certificates but exclude all bills.
Net buying of Japanese stocks by foreign investors amounted to 377.1 billion yen in September compared with net selling of 94.8 billion yen in the previous month, the ministry said.
Details of Japanese and foreigners' investments in billions of yen, were as follows:
Foreign stocks: Net Foreign bonds: Net
Japanese stocks: Net Japanese bonds: Net
Figures are rounded and based on settlements.
